## Overview

The **scSimEval Shiny Studio** is a fully self-contained, browser-based graphical interface that
gives researchers access to all 62 evaluation measures and every visualization in the package —
without writing a single line of R code.

Launch it locally in R with:

```r
library(scSimEval)
launch_scSimEval_app()          # opens in your default browser
```

> **File size limit:** The app accepts uploads up to **10 GB** per file, which comfortably handles
> large-scale single-cell and multiomics datasets.

The studio is organized into **eight primary navigation tabs** in the top navigation bar, plus an
**eight-panel Visualizations module** inside Tab 5. The sections below document every tab,
every control, and all export options in the order they appear in the application.

---

## Tab 1 — Home

The landing page introduces **scSimEval Studio**, explicitly highlighting simulation evaluation across single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq), single-cell ATAC-seq (scATAC-seq), and single-cell multiomics (scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq) datasets against real biological references across 62 evaluation measures without requiring synthetic ground truth.

The four **KPI cards** below the hero section display: 62 evaluation measures, 8 biological dimensions, 3 modalities (RNA / ATAC / Co-Assay), and the [0, 1] normalized fidelity scale.

Interactive operational mode cards showcase:
1. **Pre-computed Benchmarks:** 1-click loading of benchmark evaluations across multiple simulators and datasets.
2. **Single-Cell RNA-seq Evaluation:** Count matrix evaluation across statistical, clustering, and technical properties.
3. **Multi-Omics (RNA + ATAC) Evaluation:** Co-assay multiomics benchmarking assessing cross-modal coupling alongside unimodal properties.
4. **Upload Pre-Computed Benchmark Table:** Instant ingestion of previously calculated benchmark tables for reporting.

---

## Tab 2 — Data Hub

Data ingestion and evaluation control centre. Choose one of **four evaluation modes**
from the radio button panel on the left sidebar:

### Mode 1 — Pre-Computed Benchmark (Demo Data)

Click **Load Demo Benchmark** to instantly populate the app with pre-computed
multi-dataset results across **Simulator 1 to Simulator 6** across all 62 measures. No file uploads required.

> **Package Example Datasets vs. Shiny App Demo Data:**
> * **R Package Example Datasets (`data/`):** Lightweight, runnable count matrices (`example_scrna`, `example_scatac`, `example_multiomics`, 60 features × 80 cells) designed for rapid command-line testing of individual evaluation functions in R console sessions.
> * **Shiny App Demo Data (`inst/shiny/scSimEvalApp/data/`):** A rich pre-computed benchmark results archive (6 simulators × 62 metrics × 2 datasets = 744 metric observations) accompanied by reference and simulated count matrices (100 genes × 50 cells). This gives web users an immediate, zero-latency tour of all 8 tabs, ranking leaderboards, bubble matrices, and 8 visualization panels without requiring computationally intensive matrix evaluations.

### Mode 2 — Single-Cell Evaluation (scRNA-seq / scATAC-seq)

Evaluate one or more unimodal count-matrix simulators across single or multiple experimental datasets.

| Step | Control | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **1** | **Reference Count Matrix** | Real empirical cells. Formats: `.rds`, `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.txt`, `SingleCellExperiment`, `Seurat`. |
| **2** | **Number of Single-Cell Simulators** | 1 – 6. Generates matching upload and configuration cards. |
| **2** | **Per-Simulator Fields** | Simulator Name, simulated count matrix, runtime (seconds), peak RAM (MiB). |
| **3** | **Cell Type Labels** (optional) | `.rds` (factor / vector / data.frame) or `.csv`/`.tsv`. Downloadable sample templates (`Cell_ID,Cell_Type`) provided. |
| **3** | **Batch Annotations** (optional) | Same formats as cell types (`Cell_ID,Batch`). Downloadable sample CSV templates provided. |
| — | **Append to current benchmark** | Adds new results alongside existing ones. |
| — | **Evaluate Single-Cell Simulators** | Triggers the full 50+ metric pipeline. |

### Mode 3 — Multiomics Evaluation (scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq)

| Subtype | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Paired Co-assay** | Same individual cells in both modalities (10x Multiome, SHARE-seq). All 62 metrics including FOSCTTM and Match@1. |
| **Unpaired Profiling** | Separate cells from same tissue. Population-level cross-modal metrics evaluated; cell-pairing metrics safely skipped. |

| Step | Control | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **1** | **Reference RNA Count Matrix** | Genes × cells. |
| **1** | **Reference ATAC Count Matrix** | Peaks × cells. |
| **2** | **Number of Multiomics Simulators** | 1 – 5. Generates matching upload fields. |
| **2** | **Per-Simulator Fields** | Simulated RNA matrix, simulated ATAC matrix, name, runtime (seconds), peak RAM (MiB). |
| **3** | **Cell Type Labels / Batch** (optional) | Applied to RNA modality. |
| — | **Evaluate Multiomics Simulators** | Runs the full 62-metric multiomics pipeline. |

### Mode 4 — Upload Pre-Computed Benchmark Table (.rds / .csv)

Load output previously saved from `evaluate_simulation_accuracy()`,
`evaluate_multiomics_accuracy()`, or `evaluate_multiple_datasets()`.

### Main Panel Utilities

| Section | Content |
|---------|---------|
| **Status Banner** | Number of simulators loaded and total metrics computed |
| **Dataset Properties Summary Table** | Comprehensive per-matrix QC: Cells (N), Features (P), Sparsity (%), Cell Types, Batches, Median Library Size, Median Detected Features, Mean Expression |
| **HPC Cluster Batch Script Generator** | Export automated SLURM, PBS, or Bash cluster execution scripts to run heavy benchmarks offline on compute nodes |
| **Download Dataset Summary** | Export properties table as CSV |

---

## Tab 3 — Leaderboard & Simulator Rankings

Comprehensive composite fidelity leaderboard across all 8 evaluation categories:

* **Simulator Ranking Cards & Podiums:** Visual podium ranking simulators by overall composite fidelity.
* **Category Score Breakdown:** Detailed breakdown of performance per simulator across each individual category (Distributional Properties, Clustering, Biological Signal, Scalability, etc.).
* **Radar / Star Composite Plots:** Multi-axis radial plots highlighting simulator trade-offs, strengths, and weaknesses.
* **Custom Category Weight Sliders:** Interactively adjust the relative importance of each category to recalculate composite rankings according to specific biological priorities.
* **Export Leaderboard:** Download the tidy rankings table as CSV.

---

## Tab 4 — Comparative Bubble Matrix

The flagship visualization: every simulator × all 62 metrics in one colour-coded matrix.
Bubble **diameter** is proportional to the normalized fidelity score.
Scores ≥ 0.96 are rendered as bold square glyphs.
Simulators are rank-ordered top-to-bottom by composite average score.

* **Multi-Dataset Selector Bar:** Switch seamlessly between **All Datasets (Cross-Dataset Average)** or inspect individual datasets (**Dataset 1**, **Dataset 2**, ..., **Dataset N**) separately.
* **Minimalist vs Publication Matrix:** Toggle between a sleek, dot-matrix view and a fully annotated publication matrix.
* **Category & Modality Filtering:** Filter metrics by modality (All Categories, RNA-Specific, ATAC-Specific, or Cross-Modal Coupling).
* **High-Resolution Exports:** Export publication figures in 600 DPI JPEG or vectorized PDF.
* **Download Standalone R Script:** Generate a 100% self-contained R script with embedded data and custom ggplot2 code to reproduce the exact bubble matrix in standalone R outside Shiny.

---

## Tab 5 — Visualizations

Eight diagnostic sub-panels accessed via the **pill navigation bar**. Every sub-panel is equipped with the **Global Multi-Dataset Selector Bar** (allowing inspection of All Datasets Average or specific datasets), active dataset badges, 600 DPI JPEG / PDF downloads, and a **Download R Script** button for instant reproducibility:

### Sub-panel 1 — Evaluation Summary
`plot_evaluation_summary()` — rank-ordered horizontal bar chart across all 8 categories and composite score.

### Sub-panel 2 — Distribution QC
`plot_distribution_qc()` — grid comparing expression densities, ECDF curves, KS distances, library sizes, and zero-inflation curves between reference and simulated cells.

### Sub-panel 3 — Scalability Benchmark
`plot_scalability_benchmark()` — runtime (seconds) and memory (peak RAM in **MiB**) dashboards with Pareto efficiency frontiers, throughput (cells/sec), and resource cost index.

### Sub-panel 4 — Metric Plots
`plot_metric_boxplots()` / `plot_category_metric_bars()` / `plot_individual_metric_bar()` — score distribution boxplots and barplots across categories with Raw vs Normalized view toggles.

### Sub-panel 5 — Metric Heatmap
`plot_metric_heatmap()` — method × metric grid with exact scores in bold text, direction-aware fill colours, and unsupervised hierarchical clustering.

### Sub-panel 6 — PCA Ordination
`plot_metric_pca()` — simulators projected into performance space with discriminating metric vector loadings.

### Sub-panel 7 — MDS Metric Space
`plot_metric_mds()` — Multi-Dimensional Scaling ordination mapping simulator algorithmic proximity.

### Sub-panel 8 — Cell Embeddings (UMAP, t-SNE & PCA)
`compute_dataset_embeddings()` + `plot_dataset_embeddings()` — dimension reduction comparing reference cells directly to simulated cells, with cell-type cluster fidelity metrics.

---

## Tab 6 — Benchmark Results & Export

The central hub for data exploration and multi-format exports:

### Interactive Master Benchmark Scores Table
A full `DT` table with **per-column dropdown search boxes** for instant filtering by Dataset, Method, and Category.
Explicitly displays:
* **Score_Raw:** Raw unnormalized metric values in physical and statistical units (e.g. KS distance, Wasserstein distance, runtime in seconds, peak RAM in **MiB**, Chi-Square values, Pearson correlation).
* **Score:** Direction-aware normalized score $[0, 1]$ where 1.0 represents top fidelity.

### Multi-Format Exports

| Button | Format | Description |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| **Excel Workbook (.xlsx)** | Multi-sheet workbook (`.xlsx`) | Full benchmark scores, method rankings, dataset metadata, and scalability metrics |
| **CSV Table (.csv)** | Flat tidy table (`.csv`) | Comma-separated values for Python (pandas), Excel, or R |
| **Tab-delimited (.tsv)** | Tab-delimited table (`.tsv`) | Clean TSV export for command-line bioinformatics workflows |
| **R Data Object (.rds)** | Native R serialized object (`.rds`) | Ready for `readRDS()` in downstream R pipelines |
| **Complete Archive (.zip)** | Full ZIP data archive (`.zip`) | All tables, rankings, dataset QC summaries, and explanatory README documentation |

---

## Tab 7 — Help & Getting Started

An in-app reference guide structured into seven sections:
1. **Workflow Architecture & Pipeline** — 4-step pipeline diagram and multi-dataset processing.
2. **The Eight Evaluation Categories** — tabular reference for all 62 metrics, highlighting peak RAM in **MiB**.
3. **Score Normalization Pipeline** — direction inversion, min-max scaling, and raw vs normalized score reporting.
4. **Comprehensive Guide to the 8 App Tabs** — detailed walkthrough of each application module.
5. **Input Data Formats & Metadata Templates** — matrix structures (genes × cells), cell-type and batch annotation vectors, and sample CSV downloads.
6. **Online Documentation Links** — direct link to the GitHub Pages site (<https://kabilanbio.github.io/scSimEval>).
7. **Computational Sizing, RAM (MiB/GiB), & Guidelines** — hardware recommendations contrasting Cloud, Local Workstation, and HPC clusters.

---

## Tab 8 — Contact

Information regarding the development team at Division of Agricultural Bioinformatics, ICAR-IASRI, maintainer contacts, GitHub issues link, and recommended citations.

## R API Cross-Reference

Every Shiny control maps directly to a documented R function:

| Shiny Panel | R Function |
|-------------|-----------|
| Data Hub → Single-Cell | `evaluate_simulation_accuracy()` |
| Data Hub → Multiomics | `evaluate_multiomics_accuracy()` |
| Data Hub → Multiple Datasets | `evaluate_multiple_datasets()` |
| Bubble Matrix | `plot_benchmark_bubble_matrix()` |
| Evaluation Summary | `plot_evaluation_summary()` |
| Distribution QC | `plot_distribution_qc()` |
| Scalability Benchmark | `plot_scalability_benchmark()` |
| Metric Plots (all categories) | `plot_metric_boxplots()` |
| Metric Plots (by category) | `plot_category_metric_bars()` |
| Metric Plots (individual) | `plot_individual_metric_bar()` |
| Metric Heatmap | `plot_metric_heatmap()` |
| PCA Ordination | `plot_metric_pca()` |
| MDS Metric Space | `plot_metric_mds()` |
| Cell Embeddings | `compute_dataset_embeddings()` + `plot_dataset_embeddings()` |
| Embedding Quality Metrics | `compute_embedding_quality_metrics()` |

For complete parameter descriptions see the [Reference](../reference/index.html) index.
